prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The middle orange paper boat turned violet. Target near x50%, y59%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The cat’s yellow eyes turned blue. Target near x18%, y29%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The nearest boat lost its large central orange dot. Target near x28%, y85%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Remove only the red leaf print on the pajama sleeve at x24% y32%, replacing it with cream fabric. Target near x24%, y32%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The central teal tower lost its tiny spire. Target near x62%, y24%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The middle orange paper boat turned violet.
The cat’s yellow eyes turned blue.
The nearest boat’s large dot became a small edge dot.
The child’s outstretched sleeve lost its red leaf prints.
The central teal tower lost its tiny spire.
